Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Winter Chant, Frost Mantle, Winter's Breath, Fimbulvetr's Hush, Whiteout Drag, Glacier Lane, Frost Aegis, Spreading Rime, Snowburst, Fimbulvetr: Long Winter, Wall of White Silence.
While switched on: Winter Spirit, Ice-Edged Bearing, Rooted in the Frost, Hush of Snow, Winter-Born, Chill Aura, Snowfall Mantle, Frostbite, Hoarfrost Thorns, Thaw Recovery, Foe of Flame.
